integrity: The proof uses the source short exact sequence (4.13), the source identification of companion/pattern pieces after scalar extension, and the source proof that the two defect annihilators are relatively prime. The new step is exact localization at height-one primes; no numerical experiment substitutes for this argument.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the nonzero winding-vector and nonzero linking-vector case of the single-component satellite reduction. It is only a height-one localization statement: no global module splitting, codimension-two extension classification, Blanchfield-pairing splitting, or zero-vector case is claimed.
title: Height-one local splitting for satellite-link Alexander modules
